description_expanded: ABOUT BLESSINGS AT PIER PARK: Welcome to Blessing at Pier Park, a stunning oceanfront retreat located in the heart of Panama City Beach. Just steps away from the white sandy beach, this expansive 6-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom private home is designed for those who appreciate both luxury and comfort, accommodating up to 20 guests with ease. Step inside and experience the spacious ambiance that this property offers. The open-concept living area is perfect for gathering with friends and family, featuring large windows that flood the space with natural light and provide breathtaking views of the ocean. The modern decor and comfortable furnishings create an inviting atmosphere, making it the ideal spot to unwind after a day of adventure. The fully equipped kitchen boasts high-end appliances and ample counter space, making meal preparation a breeze. Enjoy your culinary creations at the large dining table or take your meals outside to the expansive patio, where you can soak in the sun and enjoy the fresh sea breeze. The grill master can also take advantage of either the outdoor Treager BBQ or Green Egg to grill for the entire group! Each of the six bedrooms is thoughtfully designed to provide a restful retreat, with plush bedding and stylish decor. The bathrooms are equally impressive, featuring modern fixtures and plenty of space for everyone to get ready for the day ahead. The first floor welcomes you with a cozy full-over-queen bunk room featuring a stylish ensuite bath and walk-in shower. The open living area invites relaxation with floor-to-ceiling doors showcasing Gulf views and direct access to the deck. Outside, find seating for eight, chaise loungers, and a grilling station, ideal for poolside gatherings and starry evenings. On the second level, the open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area is a showpiece of elegance and comfort. Enjoy plush furnishings, Gulf views, and a gourmet kitchen with high-end stainless-steel appliances and a marble-topped island seating eight. This floor also features a luxurious king master suite with a spa-like ensuite and a charming bunk room equipped for young adventurers. The third level offers two Gulf-front master suites with spa-inspired bathrooms and private balconies, as well as a family-friendly room with twin-over-king beds and its own ensuite. A fully equipped laundry room with dual washer-dryer sets ensures convenience during your stay. Step outside to discover the outdoor amenities, including a private pool and two grills, that make this property truly special. The private patio offers stunning ocean views, perfect for morning coffee or evening cocktails. With easy access to the beach, you can spend your days lounging in the sun or taking part in water sports. With its stunning design, premium amenities, and serene coastal setting, Blessing at Pier Park is the epitome of luxurious beachfront living. Reserve your dream getaway today! ABOUT THE AREA: The West End of Panama City Beach, Florida, is known for its serene and laid-back atmosphere, offering a more secluded and tranquil experience compared to the bustling areas in the heart of Panama City Beach. This area is characterized by its pristine white sandy beaches, crystal-clear emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico, and picturesque natural beauty. Visitors to the West End can enjoy a more peaceful beach experience with fewer crowds, perfect for relaxation and unwinding. The West End of Panama City Beach is home to a variety of charming beachfront communities, upscale resorts, and vacation rental properties, offering visitors a range of accommodation options to suit their preferences. From luxury beachfront condos to cozy beach cottages, there are plenty of choices for accommodations in this area. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the West End's proximity to natural attractions such as Camp Helen State Park and Conservation Park, where they can explore hiking and biking trails, spot local wildlife, and enjoy the beauty of the unique coastal landscape. Water sports enthusiasts can partake in activities such as paddleboarding, kayaking, and snorkeling in the calm waters of the Gulf. For those seeking dining and entertainment options, the West End of Panama City Beach offers a selection of waterfront restaurants, beach bars, and cafes serving up fresh seafood and local cuisine. Pier Park in Panama City Beach is a premier shopping, dining, and entertainment destination just two minutes away from Blessings at Pier Park. It features a vibrant mix of boutiques, popular retailers, and restaurants, plus attractions like a movie theater and live music venues. Perfect for a family outing or a leisurely stroll, Pier Park offers something for everyone in a lively coastal setting. Visitors can also explore nearby shopping areas, art galleries, and cultural attractions in the surrounding area. Overall, the West End of Panama City Beach is a hidden gem for those looking for a more peaceful and scenic beach experience, away from the hustle and bustle of the busier tourist areas, while still providing easy access to all the amenities and attractions that make Panama City Beach a sought-after destination on Florida's Gulf Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * The beach access directly behind Blessing By The Pier PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Private Pool * Pool Heat Included from Sept. 30th - May 31st * Outdoor entertaining and grills * Unobstructed Gulf views PARKING: * Free Parking up to 5 Vehicles PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Additional $1000.00 refundable security deposit charged at confirmation * Must Be 25 Years or Older * No smoking allowed * All reservations are non-refundable and we strongly encourage adding travel insurance to your reservation so that you are covered DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle, with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties, and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build lasting memories for all our guests. *Enhance your stay with our concierge service, offering bikes and golf cart rentals, plus other amenities for your convenience!

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
